whatWorked: A6 started 15 message conversations for ₱99. A4 came next with 11.

The hook named the moment, not the person: "Monthsary sa Sabado. Matcha ang lagi niyang order. Alam mo na 'to."
whatToPostNext: Show the tin and the whisk set together, ready to hand over: ₱480 and ₱350.
Give them the words: a card line, a first cup, a café date at home.
Keep day 4 for 3 AM night shift breaks, to see if second place holds.
icp.caveat: Each audience got ₱99 for 3 days, so these are small numbers: 15 conversations against 11. That clears Hunch's bar for a clear lead, but with numbers this small, next week's posts are the real check on whether it holds past one monthsary weekend.

tagalog.caption: Disyembre na, at bukod sa exchange gift at regalo sa inaanak, nandiyan pa ang regalo para sa kanya. Hindi mo na kailangang manghula. Ang Kaye's Matcha ay ceremonial-grade, nire-repack sa bahay sa 30 g na lata, ₱480 ang isang lata, at ₱350 ang bamboo whisk set. Regalong hindi na niya itatanong, kasi alam niyang nakikinig ka.
